title: Uniqueness of normalized finite Tate transport
statement: For any commutative A, N and hA:(N:A)=0, any two OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport systems of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] are equal. The inclusion into units fixes the roots comparison; the pure-generator condition fixes the scalar-extended line comparison. No positivity, finite-ring, Noetherian or nonempty-base hypothesis is needed.

source.place: The concentration, overlap, and degree-zero gluing argument

proof.text: Cancel the monomorphic roots inclusion in the two normalization equations; Iso.ext and function extensionality identify the roots families.

Transpose the line comparisons under inverse-image/direct-image adjunction. Sheafification and scalar extension identify maps out of the Tate line with maps from the roots sheaf. Evaluation is at 1 tensor z. The line normalizations and equality of roots identify these maps.
Use injectivity of the two adjunction equivalences, Iso.ext, function extensionality, and proof irrelevance to identify the transport records.
